payload.title: Migrate evaluation datasets evidence logs and traces
payload.description:
Purpose: Remove default AWS credential requirements from local evaluation artifact paths.

Owned scope:
- Reference dataset downloads.
- Evaluation root-cause evidence.
- Score-result log and trace uploads and downloads.
- Centralized authenticated dashboard-client use in evaluation paths.

Acceptance:
- Accuracy evaluation loads a stored dataset without AWS credentials.
- Feedback evaluation persists complete error evidence.
- Core-path tests make boto3.client for S3 raise and still pass.
- Transfer and checksum failures are visible and never produce partial-success fallbacks.
